# Digital Studio LF

> Web design and development studio based in Marrakech, Morocco. We build custom websites, landing pages, admin dashboards, and CRM systems for businesses in Morocco and worldwide. Delivery in 7–21 days. English, French, and Arabic support.

## Services

- [All Services](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services) — Full catalogue of websites, dashboards, CRM, booking and automation services.
- [Landing Pages](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/landing-pages) — High-converting single-page sites, delivered in 7 days.
- [Business Websites](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/business-websites) — 5–7 page brand sites, delivered in 14 days.
- [Admin Dashboards](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/admin-dashboards) — Internal tools, analytics, KPIs and role-based access.
- [Custom CRM Systems](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/crm-systems) — Lead management, pipelines, automated follow-ups and reporting.
- [CRM for Travel Agencies](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/crm-for-travel-agencies) — Booking tracking and itinerary tools for tour operators.
- [Login & Authentication Pages](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/login-pages) — Secure login, 2FA, magic links and session management.
- [Enterprise Solutions](https://digitalstudiolf.online/services/enterprise-solutions) — Multi-role platforms, API integrations, scalable architecture.

## Pricing

- [Pricing Packages](https://digitalstudiolf.online/#pricing) — Fixed pricing, no hidden fees. Login pages from $150, landing pages from $250, business websites from $700, dashboards from $1,200, CRM from $2,500.
- [FAQ](https://digitalstudiolf.online/faq) — Costs, timelines, revisions, ownership and support answered directly.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://digitalstudiolf.online/portfolio) — Websites, dashboards, CRM systems and landing pages delivered to clients.

## Location & Languages

- Based in Marrakech, Morocco (Marrakech-Safi region)
- Service-area business — serving clients in Morocco and worldwide
- Languages: English, French, Arabic
